question: Does adversarial generator feedback fail to reduce exact conditional decision distance, and does replacing that feedback improve objective geometry at early/middle/late search stages?
captureRequirement: unchanged production implementation; final populations and G/D equal saved seed1 baseline
instrumentation: After 5 native D updates, compare full-data exact-distance gradient with sampled adversarial gradient; record exact full-data distance before/after selected actual Adam updates, with no oracle or RNG calls.

diagnosticSupportCriteria.perProblemStage: At least 2 of 3 training streams reduce exact distance and seen objective nearest-distance by at least 20% vs native, with reverse training coverage no more than 5% worse. These are engineering criteria, not significance claims.

nextDecision: Choose the next single intervention from outcomes. No automatic default promotion. If geometry improves, verify same-prefix search windows in early/middle/late and then independent seeds; if only decision loss improves, investigate metric/data/representation mismatch before any online loss addition.
accounting: Every new full search and independent generated-point/prototype evaluation counted. Offline geometry never feeds online search or training.
constraints: no use of seeds 11-15 as fresh confirmation seeds
preserve all previous data and source changes

adaptiveAdditions.reason: Static cosine omits Adam/finite-step behavior. Native 20-step smoke exposed negative local directional derivatives with positive finite-step changes.
adaptiveAdditions.test: 36 copied one-step states, shorten the SAME Adam displacement to 0.1 and 0.01; 36 G/180 D updates, no oracle calls.
adaptiveAdditions.result: At full step 14/36 increase exact distance; at 0.1 or0.01 only5/36 increase. Nine finite-step reversals disappear. This is local evidence, not a long-run learning-rate fix.

adaptiveAdditions.reason: Initial complete stages show decision-distance reductions can trade against objective coverage. Candidate value cannot be concluded from these diagnostics alone.
adaptiveAdditions.preregisteredTest: Same-prefix one-batch candidate substitution at20000/50000/80000FE, then25 native fallback generations (5000FE). Modes raw, adversarial20, distance20, adversarial2000, distance2000, de, pair_only. Four problems, seed1, training stream1 fixed for selection without choosing best training stream.
adaptiveAdditions.reuse: raw LIRCMOP5 early smoke is one of the84; first-step exact replay required in all12 raw cases.
adaptiveAdditions.queryGates: Where the original prefix has no query, G substitution remains empty and native fallback fills the budget. Do not inject a candidate into an originally inactive service stage.
adaptiveAdditions.selection: Same original requested conditions/order, replace only resulting coordinates; native consumption duplicate/bound checks and DE fill remain.
adaptiveAdditions.interpretation: One-batch propagation under a common backbone; not continuous online G retraining or independent-seed superiority.20 and2000 training costs reported separately.

adaptiveAdditions.reason: All72 primary comparisons finished. 7/8 exact-distance improvement did not restore coverage. Actual-step diagnostics often had a negative local directional derivative but positive finite-step distance change; shrinking the same displacement removed9/36 local reversals.
adaptiveAdditions.test: Only G learning rate .001 -> .0001; preserve D lr=.001, G/D/Adam initial states, real datasets, native sample RNG, gradient rules,20/200/2000 checkpoints and2000 updates.
adaptiveAdditions.criteria: Compare each arm with its same-stream original-rate counterpart, separately by stage; require actual geometry/coverage improvement, not just fewer locally increasing steps. No claim about5/6 empty or insufficient archives from this experiment.

finalDecision: No production promotion: exact conditional distance improves but objective coverage and search gains remain inconsistent across stages; lower G learning rate also insufficient.
